KEMNET Technologies Limited is a leading ICT solutions company

KEMNET Technologies Limited is a leading ICT solutions company that mainly provides domain name registrations, web hosting, Web design, software development, Fiber Optic Cabling, Wireless Network Set up, Structured Cabling & CCTV, Access Control and Internet Solutions that are focused, tailored and cost-effective.

We have been operational for over a decade with our head office in Nairobi at Allamano Centre, 3rd Floor, next to Consolata Shrine, Westlands.
